Privacy policy

Last updated: 13 October 2026.

Rib Rentals takes the protection of your personal data seriously. This privacy policy explains which personal data we collect through this website, why we do so and what rights you have. We process personal data in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Who is responsible

Rib Rentals, part of Post Workboats, is responsible for the processing of your personal data. Our details are at the bottom of this page.

Which data we collect and why

Your request via the form, email or phone

When you send us a request through the form, we receive your name, email address, phone number, company, type of project, period, location, preferred boat, your message and how you found us. We use this to answer your request, prepare a quote and, if it leads to a rental, to carry out the agreement and keep our records. When you email or call us, we use the details you give us in the same way.

Where your request came from

With the form we also store the page you came from and, when it is known, the campaign or website that referred you. This shows us which channels lead to requests. This information is only linked to your request. We do not use it to follow you around the internet.

Contact from us

We may contact you by email, phone or post about your request and, where relevant, about our rental services. You can object to this at any time.

We do not publish your data and we do not sell it.

On what basis

We process your data to take steps at your request before entering into an agreement, to carry out an agreement, to comply with legal obligations (such as tax record keeping) and based on our legitimate interest in answering requests and improving our website.

How long we keep your data

We keep your data for as long as needed to handle your request. If a rental agreement follows, we keep the data for as long as the agreement and the legal retention periods require. Requests that do not lead to a rental are not kept longer than necessary.

Who we share data with

We do not sell your data. We only share it with parties that help us run the website and handle your request. We make agreements with these parties about protecting your data.

  • STROOMLIJN (app.stroomlijn.nu), the platform where requests from the form arrive and are managed.
  • GitHub (GitHub Pages), where this website is hosted.
  • Google Fonts, for the typefaces on this website. When they load, Google receives your IP address.
  • Cloudflare (cdnjs), for a code library that drives the animations.
  • YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com), for the embedded video.

Some of these parties are based in the United States or process data there. They then rely on safeguards required by the GDPR, such as the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. We may also disclose data when the law requires us to.

Website visits and cookies

This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies and, at this time, no analytics tools. Like any website, our hosting provider processes technical data such as your IP address and the time of your visit to deliver the website and keep it secure. The embedded YouTube video uses the privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com). YouTube may still receive your IP address when the video loads and may place cookies when you play it. If we start using statistics or other cookies, we will update this policy and, where required, ask for your consent first.

Your rights

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data. You can also ask us to restrict the processing, object to the processing and ask for your data to be transferred. Send your request to info@ribrentals.com. We respond within one month. To protect your data, we may ask you to identify yourself.

If you disagree with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

Security

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures against misuse, loss, unauthorised access, unwanted disclosure and unauthorised changes. This website works over a secure connection (HTTPS). If you think your data is not properly secured or you see signs of misuse, contact us at info@ribrentals.com.

Changes

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
